ideas.title: Public review of inherited Children's Services / SEND budget overspend
alternative_routes: Public-facing publication of historic forecasts vs outturns
Best Value review request to MHCLG
ideas.first_concrete_action: Scrutiny Chair tables a call-in within 30 days; published timeline of historic overspend forecasts vs outturns
opposition_counter: Children's services pressures are national — every authority faces them.
Reform are politicising statutory services to children at risk.
pre_empt_lines: Statutory care of children is unchanged — the review is into the previous administration's forecasting and contract management, not frontline practice.
Other Reform-controlled councils have used the same scrutiny route without disrupting frontline services.
ideas.precedent: Kent CC, ongoing — £620M children's services pressure exposed by Reform leader's day-1 review

ideas.title: 90-day pothole-fix blitz with public dashboard
alternative_routes: Budget amendment if extra funding required
ideas.first_concrete_action: Cabinet member for Highways publishes a postcode-by-postcode dashboard of reported potholes + repair status, refreshed weekly

ideas.title: Reverse library opening-hours cuts (where reduced under previous administration)
ideas.first_concrete_action: Publish hours-cuts timeline since 2020 + cost of restoration; Cabinet decision with full costing within 60 days

ideas.title: Civic recognition of the county / town flag (where exists)
ideas.first_concrete_action: Estates / facilities to fly the county flag on county days alongside the Union Jack
